fields.label: Warn Threshold (Absolute, NGN)
fields.description: Above this absolute variance, remarks become mandatory.

fields.label: Warn Threshold (Percent of Expected)
fields.description: Above this percent of expected total, remarks become mandatory.

fields.label: Block Threshold (Absolute, NGN)
fields.description: Above this absolute variance, requires approver role sign-off.

fields.label: Block Threshold (Percent of Expected)
fields.description: Above this percent, requires approver role sign-off.

fields.label: Require Remarks When Variance Exceeds Warn Threshold
Cashier Recovery Account (Shortage)
fields.description: Receivable from cashier when shift is short. Default 2608.

fields.label: Overage Suspense Account
fields.description: Liability held when shift has overage. Default 6224.

fields.label: Shortage Write-Off Account
fields.description: Expense account when shortage is approved for write-off. Default 9246.

fields.label: Overage Time-Barred Income Account
fields.description: Income account when stale overage is recognised. Default 7205.

fields.label: Primary Approver Role
fields.description: Users holding this role can approve block-threshold variances.

fields.label: Secondary Approver Role
fields.description: Optional second role that can also approve.

fields.label: Max Open Shift Age (Hours) Before Stale
fields.description: POS shifts open longer than this are flagged by the stale-shift watchdog.
